title: add gradecode and academyDatasets
description:
This PR adds additional packages related to Posit Academy so they can be compiled for web assembly/webR:

* academyDatasets: https://github.com/rstudio/academyDatasets
* gradecode: https://github.com/rstudio/gradecode (which is now open source)

title: Fix JSON formatting
description: This PR fixes a JSON formatting issue (trailing comma) that caused the Update Submodules job to fail here: https://github.com/r-universe/rstudio/actions/runs/19085901158/job/54525922706
